items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Lennon-Wop took the band after them. Yeah. I was no more than about...

ctx.x: Oh, that old fella, I mean, he used to play bass with me a long time ago, man, Gus Green. Remember Gus Green? Yeah. I remember him. That's an old, old magician. Old man. Old magician. Oh, I don't know what that name is. Shots. Remember Shots? Yeah, I knew that. He used to play bass. And this other fella, he got killed, they used to call him Zoot, remember him? Zoot. Yeah. He got killed by a bar room there. He used to play with the, what was the name of the Golden Leaf Band.
The Golden Leaf Band, that's the band that, you have the picture of it from August Lennon-Wop.

Who was playing, what was, Davis playing bass, fella called Davis playing bass? No, I was Lennon-Wop playing. Lennon-Wop. Well, that's after them. Yeah, that's right. Lennon-Wop took the band after them. Yeah. I was no more than about... You know who was playing trumpet?
